description: This file is a shell script containing tests for 'git svn propset' functionality. It sets up a Subversion repository, initializes a Git-SVN bridge, performs SVN property sets on files and directories, and verifies these settings via SVN commands within scripted test cases.

methods.name: set_props
methods.description: Function to set multiple SVN properties on a specified file within a subdirectory, commit the change, and append 'hello' to the file.

methods.name: confirm_props
methods.description: Function to verify that specific SVN properties match expected values for a given file within a subdirectory.
